# switch-tv-box v0.1.0 Release Notes

Switch TV Box is a GPL fork of NX-Cast 0.3.2 with a Chinese-first living-room UI,
classic AirPlay 1 RAOP audio, JPEG/PNG photo casting and bounded photo caching.
DLNA, IPTV, URL/HLS playback and paired mirroring are retained.

Extract switch-tv-box-sdmc.zip to the SD root and launch
switch/switch-tv-box/switch-tv-box.nro in application mode.

Host protocol and codec tests do not replace real Switch/iOS interoperability
testing. Old /stream mirroring, slideshow themes, metadata artwork display and
AirPlay 2 multi-room are not implemented. See docs/AIRPLAY1.md for exact limits.
